cards.name: Blackout
cards.text: Shadows cannot Attack or be Attacked until your next turn.

cards.name: Drop Shadow
cards.text: Put target Shadow into its owner's hand without its stack. Then, you may Deploy a Shadow.

abilities.text: You may Deploy or Move Shadows you control underneath any fighter you control.
During your turn, this square is considered The Void, even if a fighter is on top of it.
Relocate this Construct 1 square.

cards.name: Shadow Bolt
cards.text: Attach to a fighter you control. This fighter gains Shadow. After this fighter Moves or Uses an Action ability, you may perform the same type of Action with target other Shadow you control.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.text: After this fighter Moves or is relocated, you may swap it with target fighter in The Void. If it is unoccupied, you may instead relocate this fighter to The Void.

abilities.name: Shadow Underfoot
abilities.text: Relocate target Shadow you control underneath target friendly fighter.

abilities.name: Loomlock
abilities.text: Enemy fighters cannot Move or be relocated into or out of The Void.

abilities.name: Shadow Puppetry
abilities.text: While this fighter is in The Void, Shadows you control may take Move and Attack actions even within a stack. If they do, they Move or relocate without their stack.

abilities.name: Thread of Oblivion
abilities.text: If this fighter is in The Void, destroy all Shadows and fighters adjacent to them that share a trait with them. Then, destroy this fighter.

abilities.name: Yoke of The Void
abilities.text: During your turn, squares adjacent to this fighter are considered adjacent to The Void.

abilities.name: Avatar
abilities.text: If this fighter is destroyed, you lose the game.
